content.title: Add an available bouquet to the basket
content.description: A visitor adds a bouquet to the basket only when that bouquet is in stock, sees the basket total update to reflect what was added, and can perform this basket step on a phone as part of the storefront flow.
content.summary: Add in-stock bouquets to the basket
content.value: Lets customers build an order accurately while preventing baskets that Sarah cannot fulfill.
criteria: basket total updates to reflect added bouquets
out-of-stock bouquets are not addable to the basket
the basket flow works on a phone
